item.name: SB SANYA Wideleg Boho Pants Soft Comfy Stretchable Plus Size
item.title: SB SANYA Wideleg Boho Pants Soft Comfy Stretchable Plus Size
item.description:
Elevate your wardrobe with the SB SANYA Wideleg Boho Pants! These pants
feature a soft, comfy fit suitable for sizes 26 to 42. Crafted from a cotton
spandex blend, they offer stretchability and comfort. The wideleg design adds
a boho flair to any outfit. Perfect for casual days or relaxed evenings.
* Two side pockets for convenience and style.
* 38 inches long, these pants are a versatile length for various occasions.
* The material ensures a comfortable fit, making them ideal for plus-size wearers.
These pants are designed for both comfort and fashion. The cotton spandex
fabric provides flexibility, while the wideleg cut offers a chic look. Ideal
for those seeking a blend of practicality and style in their clothing. Enjoy
the perfect fit and feel.
